text.zh-CN: 胎盘早剥指胎盘过早与子宫壁分离，可影响胎儿供血；胎儿生长受限指宝宝在宫内生长不理想，可能与胎盘供氧和营养不足有关。还可能早产，因此团队会结合超声和母婴情况评估。
text.en: Placental abruption means the placenta separates from the uterine wall too early, potentially impairing fetal blood supply. Fetal growth restriction means growth in the womb is poorer than expected, potentially from reduced placental oxygen and nutrients. Preterm birth may also occur, so clinicians assess scans and both mother and baby.
